name: Haw Par Corporation Limited
summary: Haw Par Corporation Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, markets, and trades in healthcare products in Singapore, The Association of Southeast Asian Nations countries, other Asian countries, and internationally. It manufactures and distributes topical analgesic products under the Tiger Balm and Kwan Loong brands; and invests in quoted securities. The company also owns and leases various investment properties. In addition, it provides family and tourist oriented leisure activities primarily in the form of oceanariums. Further, the company is involved in the property development; and owning and letting properties; letting out of office spaces; and management support services.…
